verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a generative media platform, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Runway as a cloud-based platform reached through a hosted HTTP API and web, iPhone and Android apps. Nothing documents a self-hosted, on-prem or downloadable deployment, and community users ask for a client-side or offline version precisely because it doesn't exist.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
